Their task is to scour the frozen wastes for stragglers of the Iron Army, eerie, formerly human flesh-weapons. Gros and especially the inexperienced Leichte admire Esus, stronger and wiser than they. Esus has her weaknesses, though, and unhealed wounds in her heart. Somewhere out there in the vast, deadly sea of snow lie answers—to Esus' pain, and to the awful secret of this war.

(Source: Official Site)
Second season of Shin Samurai-den Yaiba.

title_english: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
synopsis: Sequel to Seishun Buta Yarou wa Santa Claus no Yume wo Minai.
Second season of Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu.

In a modern martial arts world, Zhao Xin unexpectedly inherits the Celestial Realm's recycling station. This grants him not only the aid of numerous immortals but also the admiration of many beauties, ultimately leading him to the pinnacle of martial arts.

(Source: WeTV)
Second season of Hotel Inhumans.

title_english: One Piece: Dr. Chopper's Adventure Checkup - Traitors Masquerade
synopsis: The ninth recap special of the Egghead arc.

For centuries, the Poison Masters have perfected the art of assassination. Among them, the Gero family stands as one of the five most powerful families of Masters, wielding unmatched skill and influence. Hikaru Gero, heir to this infamous bloodline, has lived his life deep in the shadows of the underworld, far removed from love or marriage.

However, to ensure the Poison Master bloodline does not die out, the head of the Gero family declares that Hikaru's sister will be forced to bear an heir. Soon after, Hikaru crosses paths with Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler who also happens to be his current assassination target. Determined to protect his sister and solve the succession problem himself, Hikaru makes an unexpected request on the spot—asking Mei to help him get married.

"...That's the first time anyone's ever proposed like that."

And so, with the cunning marriage swindler Mei as his advisor, the elite assassin Hikaru sets out on the toughest mission for love. His goal?

title_english: Gals Can't Be Kind to Otaku!?
synopsis:
Meet Takuya Seo, an otaku who sits behind the popular gals in class, Ijichi and Amane. Since they're people from different "castes," you wouldn't expect them to have much in common. But when their worlds collide over a borrowed eraser, Takuya slips up about his favorite anime, and Amane...is rather quick to correct him. She says she's not a fan, but her familiarity with the series suggests otherwise. Could she be...a fellow geek?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title_english: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand.
synopsis:
The sorcerer Luck believes this to be the end. Besieged by powerful demons, he makes the noble sacrifice of holding back their onslaught while his friends escape. Never sleeping or resting, Luck endures the clash of swords, rain of blood, and never-ending stream of enemies. Against all odds, he vanquishes the commander and emerges victorious, only to find that 10 whole years have passed in the meantime. Furthermore, his body has regressed in age to the point where he looks like a mere teenager.

Following his triumph, Luck soon reunites with his friends, the hero Eric Imgard Mendirival and warrior Goran Morton. As they believed Luck to be dead, the pair made sure he went down in history as a hero and prepared to quell the rise of the demons themselves, unaware of Luck's feat. With all this in mind, Luck just wants a laid-back life, so he applies as a novice adventurer under the name Lock and sets out on a journey alongside brand new companions.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Fifteen years ago, Luofeng City was struck by a bizarre catastrophe, becoming a dead and silent ruin overnight. The young Ding Xiao, born at the age of seven, was granted a place in the Town Spirit Division. However, he destroyed his own spirit and became a coffin carrier for the Gui Tribe. For five years, he experienced the vicissitudes of life. Unexpectedly, he awakened his physiognomy in the face of adversity, excelled in the promotion assessment, and became a feared figure in the Spirit Division. Now, evil spirits are rising in all directions, and strange events are endless. To cure his sister Ding Ling's increasingly strange illness, Ding Xiao resolutely restarts his spiritual awakening journey, only to be drawn into an unfathomable vortex of political intrigue. The hidden truth of Luofeng City gradually unfolds, and behind all this, the fate of Ding Ling is inextricably intertwined...

(Source: Youku, translated)

A brilliant epilogue depicting the dazzling "present" of those who have grown since "those days" and the important people surrounding them!

(Source: Official X Account)
An animated PV to commemorate the collaboration between Mahjong Soul and the TV anime Gintama.

An abnormal phenomenon has been observed in Kaga, where Akina and his friends live.
A town shrouded in thick fog, a great tower standing sentinel…
This is the Fantasma.

——On the night when the crimson moon rises, they shall become "Fantôme."

(Source: Official Site)
Second season of Witch Watch.
Third season of Cang Yuan Tu.

title_english: One-Punch Man: Get It All in One Punch! Season 2 Serious Recap!
synopsis: Commemorative recap of One Punch Man 2nd Season.

Scientist Chu Feng accidentally obtains the "Golden Crow Token," which fell as a meteorite. To investigate its origin, Chu Feng creates the supercomputer "Origin." With Origin's help, Chu Feng learns that the Golden Crow Token comes from a mysterious world called the Martial Soul Continent. Chu Feng also inadvertently activates the token's power and is transported to the Martial Soul Continent. There, Chu Feng rescues Su Manqing, the third young lady of the Su family, but in doing so, he incurs enmity with the Nangong and Lu families. To cope, Chu Feng quickly familiarizes himself with the martial arts of the Martial Soul Continent while constantly guarding against the Nangong family's schemes, overcoming crisis after crisis. However, gradually, the secret of Chu Feng possessing the Golden Crow Token is discovered by Su Yuwei, the patriarch of the Su family, and others, attracting the covetous eyes of various forces. After escaping a near-death experience, Chu Feng learns of the myster
Third season of Dinoster: Gonglyongsuhodae.

All things possess a spirit, and the power of nature coalesced into various conscious fairies. However, due to humanity's neglect of nature and the awakening of suppressed powers, the fairies have been harmed. A human girl encounters a fairy from the depths of the water and they have known each other for many years. However, they cannot overcome the barrier between celestial and mortal. On a wondrous journey, the girl resolves to find her own power. She believes that humanity is also part of nature, and that there must be a way for humans and nature to coexist harmoniously. Can she protect nature?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

People become ‘ghouls’ upon dying, and will enter the physical world through a door to cause chaos. Zhang Zha, a mere delivery boy, accidentally entered a haunted house, and resulted in a crisis— a ‘ghoul’ breakout. As such, people from all factions began to make an appearance in the story, while Zhang Zha continues to grow upon experiencing a series of adventures and fights with a mysterious scroll about modern Jianghu slowly unfolding alongside.

(Source: MU)

To resurrect his beloved Ning Yudie, Luo Zheng embarks on a heaven-defying path unlike any before. At the Tianyu Realm, he turns against Tianqiong, yet beneath the Shenqi Tower, they fight together. Through blurred lines of love and hatred, and trials that temper flesh and bone, he forges his path to divinity. Now, having ascended to the superior realm, Luo Zheng is determined to break the chains of fate and become the one truly free from destiny's grasp... But a deadly threat that exists beyond even heaven's will is now closing in.

(Source: Youku)

The young human Wang Dong vowed to avenge his parents and joined the Storm Squad, determined to exterminate the Zhage insect species across the solar system. Through hardships, he awakened his Blade Warrior powers, upgraded his armor and skills, and ultimately uncovered the insects' ultimate plot on Earth along with his team. Facing overwhelming swarms, Wang activated his ultimate Blade Warrior form and defeated both human traitors and the insect leader Ying Yuan.

(Source: Youku)

In order to resist the foreign evil organization that intends to destroy the Great Zhou Kingdom, the genius wizard Zuo Xiao gathered four sacred artifacts, practiced the five elements magic, protected the dragon veins of the Great Zhou Kingdom, and defeated the foreign evil forces one by one.

(Source: Youku, Google translated)

In 2145, a century after the nuclear apocalypse triggered by the "New Human Project," which aimed to fully unleash humanity's potential, the surviving humans established a new social order on the wasteland. In this new world built upon technology, superpowers, and magic, Jiang Li, the only "complete New Human," awakens from hibernation and begins his legendary story.

(Source: Youku, translated)

Orphan Qin Yu was specially admitted to the top cultivation academy, Dongda Martial Academy. Behind the city's calm, a demonic threat quietly approached. Qin Yu vowed to lead his fellow disciples to resist the invading demons.

(Source: Youku)

title_english: Threads of Fate: A War Untold
synopsis:
Shang prince Youshen Bupo rescued Jiang Li, disciple of Taiyi Sect, and the two of them traveled together, adventuring across the vast wilderness. They joined a merchant caravan, encountered heavenly tribulations, faced fierce beasts, defeated bandits, and rescued the heroine… Bound together by fate, the two became embroiled in a great war between the Xia and Shang dynasties.

(Source: Youku)

Prince Ning Ming was chosen by a demon star and became the source of corruption in the world. To discover his origins and cleanse the corruption, he joined a secret agency. On his quest for the truth, the powerful Lord of the Ming granted Ning Ming extraordinary abilities, the supreme Emperor of the Zhou protected him, the daring Nightingale sisters favored him, and various prodigies willingly risked everything to help him cleanse the world of corruption. As he neared the truth, Ning Ming witnessed the world's cruelty and vowed to eliminate all corruption and save humanity.

(Source: Youku)

The Pure Sea's currents flow from north to south, constantly flowing through this world. People build homes and thrive on the backs of giant beasts. Every wish has its response. The deity known as Fan Ying warns that only by letting your wishes run wild can you reap the rewards of miracles and survive. However, the unchanging rules are about to change, and those who transcend fate will eventually follow the origin of all things.

(Source: Tencent, Google translated)
Seventh season of Wu Dong Qian Kun.

The descent of Mount Tianzun and the appearance of the Spiritual Treasure Cauldron ignited a frenzied struggle among the God-Kings for the "Azure Heaven Seal," the "Earth Seal," and the "Seal of Ten Thousand People." Qin Yu, a new father, is drawn into a conflict with powerful enemies like the Blood Sea Queen to save his brother Hou Fei. When Jiang Lan obtains the Earth Seal and becomes the target of everyone's anger, Qin Yu displays astonishing strength, intimidating the assembled heroes. However, the appearance of the Seal of Ten Thousand People brought even more brutal bloodshed. The Blood Sea Queen, disregarding the bloodshed of the God-Kings to seize the Seal of Ten Thousand People, Qin Yu, in a rage, slays powerful enemies to reclaim it. To end this conflict, he devises a scheme, luring those who coveted the seal into his mysterious domain, where he settles old scores. Ultimately, the three seals merge, and a new Heavenly Venerable is born. However, old grudges remain unresolved,

After the Flame Witch incident, Mo Fan returned to his training at the Magic City Academy, but at the most crucial moment, news suddenly arrived that his good friend Zhang Xiaohou had gone missing. The sentimental Mo Fan immediately halted his competition and, together with his vampire friend Liu Ru, rush to the ancient capital, venturing into the heart of the region where demons were active.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title_english: The Almighty Mage SP: Beiyuan Crisis
synopsis:
Mo Fan, Lingling, Zhao Manyan, and others come to Beiyuan to investigate the mysterious destruction of Beiyuan Village. During their investigation, they discover that it was the work of Leng Jue of the Black Church, who was parasitized by the Red Beast, who colluded with the evil forces of Nile. They also discover that there is an even bigger conspiracy behind them. When faced with the Red Beast's trap again, what actions will Mo Fan and his companions take?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Traversing countless worlds, reborn through endless quests, a blood-stained pact forged a night of beheadings. A merciless blade swept across the seven paradises, scattering countless heads and transforming the hunter Su Xiao into a terrifying symbol. Yet, even as killing became a daily routine, life and death a minor matter, he could not forget the death of his parents. The sinister smile of the gray gentleman beneath his hat, the eerie totems rising from corpses, and the oppressive might of the ancient god in the darkness gradually revealed the truth of that year. Chasing the true culprit, carrying on the legacy of the extermination of the law, and restoring balance to the elements became his inevitable destiny.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Zhou Ming travels back in time and becomes Captain Duncan of the Lost Homeland, a terrifying evil god known as the Moving Scourge. In this deep-sea world created by an ancient god, the old order has been shattered, and isolated island cities are the only remaining lights of civilization. Yet, the shadows of the past lurk within the depths. Captain Duncan leads a diverse crew, delving into the perilous depths, and gradually begins to uncover history, glimpsing a glimpse of a despairing truth.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title_english: Slay the Gods Movie: The Dead of Cangnan
synopsis:
After the release of the divine artifact Shiva's Wrath, Cangnan City faces an unprecedented crisis. With the Western evil gods lurking in their wake, are the Chinese gods about to awaken? Infused with the power of the twin gods, Lin Qiye joins the Night Watchmen of Cangnan City in fighting against the Western evil gods and defending Cangnan! The Second War of the Gods is about to begin!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After the Li Zhu Grotto-Heaven collapses, Chen Ping’an takes on a great responsibility to escort Li Baoping and the others to Great Sui to study. Their journey is extremely dangerous, with enemies and supernatural threats along the way, but they receive help from the mysterious swordsman A Liang and other powerful figures. Traveling far and fighting countless battles, the young man grows stronger while learning the weight of responsibility.

(Source: WeTV)

The story features a distinct world setting, a diverse genre, and bizarre and treacherous spirit realm dungeons. The protagonist, Zhang Yuanqing, becomes a night-wandering deity thanks to a mysterious black card, only to be caught in a maelstrom of conspiracy pitting good against evil.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Under the grand strategy of interstellar travel, humanity has entered the space age, but simultaneously faces the threat of UMA, a high-dimensional extraterrestrial life form from Ganymede, a being capable of devouring human consciousness and evolving itself. Xu Xinghe, a bright student who should be pursuing higher education, witnesses his brother being devoured by the alien creature, awakens special abilities, and embarks on a journey to find his brother's consciousness and fight against UMA. Along the way, he partners with the mysterious girl Jiang Yao, and the fate of humanity and UMA is about to reach a major turning point.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In 2063, Earth enters the gaming era. Young Ye Hao awakens a legendary account, turning the tide for his family, defeating powerful monsters from another world, winning the heart of a young girl, and ultimately stopping a world-destroying conspiracy to protect his family.

(Source: Yuewen YouTube Channel)

After a three-year, six-thousand-mile odyssey, Xu Fengnian, the world's most dissolute playboy, returns to Beiliang. Facing his father, Xu Xiao, he realizes that the Northern Liang sword will ultimately be his own. This time, his servant, Old Huang, offers his life as a token of his loyalty, respectfully inviting the prince into the martial arts world. Xu Fengnian no longer hides his power, but boldly draws his sword, facing the dual threat of the imperial court and the martial arts world, realizing his master plan and gradually uncovering the truth behind his mother, Wu Su's, death.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After being confined to Qingshan Mental Hospital, the gifted young man Chen Ji kills the enemy who killed his parents. He then accidentally travels back in time to the ancient world and becomes an apprentice at the Ning Dynasty Medical Clinic. Involved in a case involving the Secret Service, he becomes a non-staff member of the agency, only to discover he's also a spy for the enemy nation. The story revolves around this dual identity. Trapped in the maelstrom of power, Chen Ji secretly fights for survival, using modern knowledge to deconstruct spiritual cultivation systems and maneuvering to overturn the chessboard. Ultimately, he transforms from pawn to master, wielding the Qingshan Mountains as his blade, vowing to shatter the hypocrisy of heaven!

(Source: Tencent, Google translated)

A perpetual night of catastrophe, terror descends, and strange phenomena abound! A young man, Wang Ye, is inexplicably chosen by the "Mysterious Post Office" to serve as a "ghost messenger," awakening his special powers and repeatedly embroiling himself in dangerous and paranormal phenomena. Witness how Wang Ye pushes the envelope, dispelling the mysteries and igniting the flames of humanity's survival amidst the terrifying darkness.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

It uses a changing world line to make forward-looking reflections on the technological explosion, integrates intellectual games into urban legends, and opens up a new realm of "intellectual battle literature".

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The moment the first gleam of sunlight trickled in gently stirring the folds of a shallow sleep—that was when the graffiti appeared...

(Source: Official Site)

In the city, people lived under the protection of a barrier, enjoying a peaceful life. Secretly, the Fortune Star agents of the Sword Bureau had been battling the calamity creatures for decades. When Fortune Star agents were kidnapped, the creatures swarmed the city, bringing devastation. The reclusive youth Chen Kefan, competing in an e-sports tournament, encountered an invasion of bloodblade bugs and witnessed the killer of his parents reappear. In the desperate fight, his latent Fortune Star power awakened, setting him on a path of revenge. Yet, as he and his comrades fought bloodily and risked their lives, they discovered that the apocalypse was merely a game played by the gods.

(Source: Youku)

The hero, gifted with extraordinary abilities and from a powerful Daoist sect, left his sect at his master's invitation to exorcise ghosts. After clearing two haunted houses, he became entangled in a series of bizarre events while facing challenges from various factions: he clashed with a Thai sorcerer, dealt a crushing blow to Japanese Onmyoji, fended off a Korean witch's challenge, and humiliated Western exorcists—defeating and banishing masters from across the world. In a realm where technology intertwined with the supernatural, he slayed demons and spirits, growing into a legendary Celestial Master.

(Source: Youku)

On the world's dark edge, forbidden powers are growing. When high schooler Yan Feng is drawn into a deadly incident, he joins a secret organization to save his sister, contain sinister artifacts, and battle villains bent on unleashing these powers. As the fight intensifies, he begins to uncover the truth about his own origins.

(Source: Youku)

At the start of the new year, college student Chu Lan's ordinary life ended abruptly. With his loved ones dead and a demon possessing him, he was drawn into a thousand-year struggle of fate. He became both the "only key" to end the disaster and the "vessel of evil" that could destroy humanity. Forced by destiny, he joined a secret agency to break the endless cycle of the Spirit Calamity. Ultimately, he faced a choice at the end of the battle between good and evil.

(Source: Youku)

The young Han Jin bore a future Dao embryo, wielded mystical powers, defeated nine dark realms, and overcame inner demons, forging a path to save humanity and defy fate.

(Source: Youku)

A tech giant corporation discovered an ancient time rift connecting higher-dimensional space. To monopolize energy, the tech giant concealed this discovery from the world. Its relentless exploitation eventually caused the temporal rift to go out of control, allowing non-Earthly spiritual energy to spread across the globe. Capitalizing on this upheaval, the giant accelerated its monopoly over the world. Gradually, more and more heroes capable of forging contracts with deities through spiritual energy united to oppose the evil forces intent on destroying humanity.

(Source: Youku)

The Ye family was suddenly massacred—Ye Beichen's parents and brothers were slaughtered, and he himself was ruthlessly thrown into the moat, clinging to life by a thread. Rescued by his senior sister, he was taken to Kunlun Mountain, where he spent five grueling years mastering martial arts. Five years later, he returned in full force, armed with the peerless skills taught by 99 invincible masters. Back in the mortal world, when faced with old enemies and powerful factions, Ye Beichen showed no fear. With extraordinary martial prowess and overwhelming strength, he unleashed chaos across the city, carving a path of revenge and dominance—turning the tables and crushing all who once sought his downfall.

(Source: Youku)

The inhabitants of the Upper City live in luxury high above the clouds, while those of the Lower City struggle to survive in a wasteland overrun by monstrous beasts and shrouded in poisonous miasma. Ning Fan, a poor student from the Lower City, becomes a wanderer who takes on high-risk jobs to earn money in order to save his mother. From then on, he steps into an endless killing field, leading his team to defy fate and ultimately shatter the heavenly ladder, determined to burn away the cage of destiny with a prairie fire.

(Source: Youku, translated)

In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens.

(Source: Youku)

In an out-of-control world, survivors faced a thrilling and perilous apocalyptic battlefield.

(Source: Youku)

2283, in a post-nuclear wasteland, Fortress City 021 was controlled by Ark Corporation. Their so-called "Savior Guardians" appeared to protect humanity but secretly conducted human experiments using X chips and manipulated public opinion. Young Han Che witnessed his brother's murder by the false Guardians and unexpectedly awakened the "1307 Source System" within him, gaining superpowers. He joined the Yebushou organization, rebuilt by Guan Shanhu, and fought alongside hacker Tian Xin and engineer Kang Di. Yebushou infiltrated Ark training camps and Ghost Island Prison, exposing a plot to create a superpowered army using experiments and mutants. As Han Che unlocked new abilities and faced formidable enemies like Emperor Angel and Divine-Eye Immortal, he embarked on a path of vengeance, truth, and salvation. However, the hidden AI "Lefu" was plotting to control all human consciousness.

(Source: Youku)

Lu Xiaobai, an ordinary high schooler, is suddenly attacked by "Xiao", a higher-dimensional envoy. On the brink of death, he awakens time-based powers and is rescued by his future self, "Cang". Taking up his late father's mission, Lu Xiaobai takes over the leadership of the Bureau of Demon Defense, an organization dedicated to defending humanity. Together with Cang and new allies, he confronts a series of crises sparked by villains, ultimately drawing out and defeating them, reshaping the timeline, and saving humanity from a doomed future.

(Source: Youku)

A parasitized boy killed his cruel master and became the strongest supernatural hunter. Using his bizarre form, he hunted the mysterious, ultimately transforming into a "Mad Killing God," saving humanity at the cost of everything he cherished.

(Source: Youku)

To resist invasions from other worlds, the Heavenly Great Sage founded Tianguan Academy. Every year, the Academy would recruit new students—but in the end, only nine could become the official Heavenly Officers. Gu Tian, a young soccer player, accidentally awakened his hidden power while saving someone on the field. Invited by his senior Xia Zhi, he boarded Subway Line 36 to Tianguan Academy. With the world's finest teachers, strict assessments, and a brutal elimination system, the Academy pushes its students to the limit. By a stroke of fortune, Gu Tian became the 81st student to pass the entrance trial. Under the guidance of celestial masters, he studied spells and divine decrees, honed his combat skills against powerful rivals, and strode forward step by step toward the ultimate goal of becoming one of the Nines.

(Source: Youku)

Xu Yichuan accidentally travels into a nightmarish realm and awakens the ability to regenerate. To escape this twisted dimension and return to his family, he gathers a group of partners to brave deadly games and unlock abilities. But it turns out that all this is a death trap conspired by the realm's supreme overseer. In the end, Xu Yichuan and his companions manage to break through the overseer’s grip and keep looking for ways to escape.

(Source: Youku)

College student Liu Ye accidentally entered a mysterious pawnshop, awakened his bloodline powers, and inherited the Mountain-Seeking Map. In rescuing a friend, he unlocked the map's mysterious spells, gradually sensing ties from his past life with Bai Ze. The unusual abilities of Liu Ye drew the attention of the Supernatural Bureau, which sent the elite Lu Li to intervene under the pretext of "supervision." At the same time, the pawnshop heiress Lin Nianyu began pursuing him to seize the map, and the three formed separate demon-sealing teams with their own agendas.

(Source: Youku)

The hero of the Star Federation, "Beidou", was framed as a traitor and imprisoned. A decade later, Yang Bei returned to clear his name, embarking on an adventure with the Federation President's daughter to find allies. Ultimately, Yang Bei exposed the conspiracy and reclaimed his status as a star hero.

(Source: Youku)

Tuke is a spirit guardian exiled to the mortal realm. For centuries, he's protected humanity with eight other spirit guardians. But the River God's Son, who was sealed away by them, breaks free and takes control of seven spirit guardians' souls, plotting to transform the world into a purgatory. To save his friends and defeat the River God's Son, Tuke ventures all the way to the Son's stronghold, where an epic battle ensues...

(Source: Youku)

A low-level office worker accidentally consumed a demon and underwent a mutation. Struggling to survive, he hunted evil, seeking light and justice.

(Source: Youku)

Rei Ichidou, Gou Reietsu, Kiyoshi Shusse, Jin Daima, and Dai Monohoshi are five mischievous boys attending Ichiou Junior High. Each with an eccentric personality and a knack for chaos, they've earned a reputation as the infamous "Kimen-gumi."

One day, new transfer student Yui Kawa and her friend Chie Uru encounter the group and soon find themselves drawn into their antics. Around them are other colorful cliques—from the handsome "Iro Otoko-gumi" led by Shou Kireide, to the delinquent "Ban-gumi" led by You Nihiruda, the athletic "Ude-gumi" led by Kai Undou, and the tough girl squad "Onna-gumi" led by Jako Amano.

As time passes and a new spring begins, the everyday lives of these eccentric students unfold in a lively and comedic school story.

(Source: MAL News)

title_english: Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans – Urdr Hunt Special Edition: Path of the Little Challenger
synopsis:
Year P.D. 323. Gjallarhorn's political intervention into the Arbrau central parliament escalated into an armed conflict using mobile suits. The incident was brought to an end by Tekkadan, a group of boys who came from Mars.

News of Tekkadan's exploits has also reached the ears of Wistario Afam, a youth born and raised at the Radonitsa Colony near Venus. Venus, which lost to Mars in the contest for development, is a remote frontier planet in which the four great economic blocs show little interest. It is now used only as a penal colony for criminals, whose inhabitants don't even have IDs.

Then Wistario, who hopes to change the status quo of this homeland, encounters a girl who claims to be the guide to the Urdr-Hunt.

(Source: Gundam Global Portal)

Set to Digimon Story Time Stranger's theme song "wherever you are", the Prelude short focuses on Inori and her younger brother just before the main story's events.

(Source: Youtube)

title_english: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You Season 3
synopsis: Third season of Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo.

title_english: The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!
synopsis:
Hibiki, a high school student who was suddenly transferred to another world, wanders alone in a vast grassland of a fantasy world where monsters inhabit. All he has are non-combat skills such as "Appraisal"! From a hopeless situation, he is saved by encounters, and his all-powerful abilities blossom! An another world adventure tale of miraculous reversal cheats burst forth!

(Source: AlphaPolis)
Second part of Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 3rd Season.
Promotional video commemorating P.A. Works' 25th anniversary, showcasing the anime the company has made over the years.
Original Kusuriya no Hitorigoto movie.

In the year 2045, singing has been forbidden. Music is no longer created or performed by humans; instead, a music application called MiucS produces all songs on their behalf.

One day, a girl named Seria Aiba hears a human singing voice while out with her friends—something that should no longer exist. Following the sound, she encounters a mysterious presence: a ghost. What appears before her is not an ordinary spirit, but a figure from beyond this world known as a Great Ghost.

As Seria becomes drawn into encounters involving Great Ghosts, the psychic organization TERA, and a strange song known as the Possession Requiem, she finds herself stepping into a hidden side of a world that has erased human music.

This is the story of how Seria's life begins to change—and the path that leads her toward becoming a ghost herself.

(Source: MAL News)

In an alternate version of the early 20th century where technological progress evolved along a different path shaped by steam power, Kyoto is blanketed in constant smoke.

A boy, hardened by the loss of his brother, grows distrustful after their shared dream of an "Age of Electricity" is cut short. A deeply devout girl hides her dreams and regrets for her deceased mother deep within her heart. When the two cross paths, they set about exploring the secrets of the 20th Century Electrical Catalog, a glimpse into the future they long for.

Together, they must confront their pasts and carve a path toward the future they once believed in.

(Source: Press Release)

Three short episodes featuring Mega Evolution Pokémon released on the Pokémon Official YouTube Channel. Episode one features Mega Kangaskhan, episode two features Mega Gardevoir, and episode three features Mega Altaria.

title_english: Resonance Solstice: A Day in the Life of the Conductor
synopsis:
An ordinary day, an extraordinary encounter!
On the very first day of duty, what awaits is… GAME OVER?!

(Source: YouTube)

title_english: Aikatsu! Memorial Stage: Shining Unit Cup
synopsis:
It has been announced that the "Unit Cup" will be held at Starlight School's middle school.

The eight units selected to participate in the Unit Cup are raring with excitement. This time, there will also be a corner unique to the event where idols will report on each other's true selves behind the scenes.

The idols clash more passionately than ever!? Right here and now, the curtains rises on the Unit Cup! 

(Source: All Aikatsu! Wiki)

title_english: Magical Girl holoWitches! The Stage: Trick or Magic!
synopsis:
A 3D concert stage performance featuring songs, light theatrical elements, and appearances by two special guests.

The special guests are Ookami Mio and Nao Higashiyama.
Second season of Bungou Stray Dogs Wan!.

Maria, the daughter of a duke, grew up believing she would one day inherit her father's dukedom. Accordingly, she focused her attentions on honing her martial arts prowess, while thoughts of marriage fell by the wayside. But the arrival of a baby brother in her family means she's losing her role as heir! Now that she's decided it's time to marry after all, she's arrived a little late to the game! Are there even any eligible bachelors left?

Upon going to study abroad in a neighboring country where she might still stand a chance at getting hitched, she's bewildered when the crown prince there declares before all that his engagement to her is null and void! Wait... what engagement?!

Apparently, he's mistaken her for the wrong girl! But once that's all cleared up and he catches sight of her knocking out a whole pack of bandits, it turns out that this prince may have a thing for ass-kicking young ladies after all.

(Source: Square Enix)

Tsukuyomi is a virtual realm where hopes and dreams come together. Iroha Sakayori, a 17-year-old high school student in Tokyo, leads an extremely busy life trying to balance part-time work and academics. She finds peace by watching a popular streamer named Yachiyo Runami, who is the administrator of an online virtual space called Tsukuyomi.

Iroha frequents Tsukuyomi, where people can live different lives and freely pursue their creativity, and she passes the time by supporting Yachiyo and playing battle games to earn a little extra money. On her way home one day, Iroha finds a telephone pole shining with iridescent hues. To her surprise, an adorable baby emerges from the pole. Unable to abandon it, Iroha takes the infant home and watches her rapidly grow into a girl her own age.

Aika is a gyaru with a dual personality: she acts kindly to her parents, but shows a brattier side to others, including Kouta. Aika quickly develops a fondness for her new stepbrother, and the two form a sexual relationship.

This playboy prince saves the witch Anna at an execution scene and is shocked to discover that magic really exists in this medieval-style otherworld.

When Anna, as a witch, displays her magical skills, Roland realizes that magic can replace some modern technology, so he formulates a "great development of magical industry" plan. Thus, in an era where everyone hates witches, the independent Roland begins to recruit witches, using their magic to transform Border Town and improve the lives of himself and the locals.

In addition to using magic to develop industry, Roland also introduces modern business ideas to Border Town. Under Roland's leadership, people manufacture firearms, and Roland gains public support. title_english: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
synopsis:
On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Mano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see. Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side.

(Source: Yen Press)

Two inquisitive kids, Tamo and Haru, might be the last people on Earth. They explore the silent, overgrown ruins of what was once rural Japan, documenting their discoveries in a notebook. When they come across a disused commuter train, and find out that it's operational, who knows where it will take them? A disconcertingly cheerful and childish interpretation of the end of the world.

(Source: fantasiafestival.com)

Nuclear winter has arrived, civilization has collapsed, and humanity is no longer the master of the world. Species mutations and scarce resources create an unpredictable future and environment, leading to a series of crises. To protect themselves, humanity has built walls, but outside these walls, survival depends on blood and fire. The protagonist, Ren Xiaosu, and his younger brother, Yan Liuyuan, are among them. They were just ordinary teenagers in the wilderness, without shelter or a way out; their only support was each other. But fate granted them the power to awaken in their dire circumstances. The Jingshan earthquake caused the collapse of Wall 113, fully shattering the post-apocalyptic chaos. During their escape, Ren Xiaosu and his family rescued Luo Lan, the military leader, and entered Wall 109. A new life was about to begin, but the real test had only just begun…

With the creative theme of "extreme emotion + independent theme," it does not restrict the creative form, exploring the possibilities of animation together with the team. The aim is to collaboratively create original short films with diverse styles and characteristics, and to help Chinese animators reach the world stage. "Miracle" represents transcending conventions and breaking through limitations to achieve extraordinary success, often accompanied by a sense of mystery that inspires awe and curiosity. What miracles will occur in these 10 stories?

A wandering swordsman named Shao Xia, an amnesiac pharmacist named Wuming, a passionate constable named Susu, and a royal pharmacist named Xu Changqing form an alliance while searching for a mysterious monster. They gradually uncover the dark truth behind the city. The group must choose between trust and betrayal, power and consequences, attempting to save themselves and others in this unbalanced world.

This ultimately triggered a great war between humans and demons, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides. During this time, Su Yu, the host of Wangshu, disagreed with the Qionghua Sect's cultivation philosophy and left the sect with Yun Tianqing. The demon realm seized the opportunity to escape, and the Qionghua Sect's leader perished in the war. 

The two married on Qingluan Peak and had a son, Yun Tianhe. They both died young due to the icy cold that invaded their bodies. Young Yun Tianhe grew up alone on Qingluan Mountain. However, she discovers the strangeness and danger of this world in her work: various bizarre polluting monsters, the world's strange operating rules, and even her own strange self… Zhu Ning gradually uncovers a huge secret hidden behind the world, which also brings her immense danger. In this unknown post-apocalyptic world, Zhu Ning is forced into complex conflicts, searching for the truth about herself and the world.

In the year 20XX, space development had progressed beyond the present day, and humanity had expanded its living spaces across many planets. On the far edge of the galaxy lies the Countryside Planet, home to Moyori Obayashi, a first-year high school student who enjoys collecting scraps and discarded things, and her friend Kayo Daijamori, a girl who dreams of magic and loves to imagine other worlds. This is the story of a mysterious summer day they share. Set in a society increasingly focused on standardizing and controlling people, the story asks how the overlooked, undefined spaces—those pushed out of view—may hold something essential for preserving our humanity and the freedom to be ourselves.

With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a "landmine" girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara's attention, he discovers she isn't nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl... if a little weird.

Hesitantly, Kuroki begins to learn more about Chihara and her strange quirks. Is there more to her than her volatile reputation? Or is all the dark clothing just a red flag in disguise?

Zero Rise is about a group of young athletes who have lost their place in the basketball world due to past mistakes and harsh realities. In a society where the divide between wealth and poverty is stark, these determined players must battle against the odds in a cutthroat underground league known as "Zero Rise." As they fight not only for their dreams but for redemption and a shot at a brighter future, they must navigate treacherous challenges that demand both skill and integrity. In this unforgiving world, they are forced to discover what it truly means to rise from the streets—leaving them with one final question: will they find their second chance, or will the rules of survival break them?

(Source: MAL News)

In a fictional sci-fi world, alien beings known as "Hundred-Beak" intend to control the consciousness of all humanity. A young girl named Li Haila unites with a human force to resist the alien invasion, learns the mystery of her own origins, and ultimately thwarts the alien life form's plan, protecting the fate of humanity.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
An animated video on the Cardfight Vanguard YouTube Channel to celebrate the 15th anniversary of Cardfight Vanguard containing new animated scenes.

One does not need dance to live.

In 1374, during the turbulent age when the Northern and Southern Courts were locked in conflict, the Northern Court's shogun, Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, was becoming an increasingly dominant force.

Born the son of Kanami, head of the Kanze troupe of sarugaku performers, Oniyasha drifts through his days with a hazy question lodged in his heart: Why do people dance? His spirit remains clouded, until the day he encounters a dance that is truly "good."

Curious, sensitive, and strikingly beautiful, the boy meets people, laughs, cries, confronts his own weaknesses, and slowly begins to shape a new form of dance for a world steeped in impermanence.

(Source: Shochiku)

Ye Cangxuan, a supreme cultivator of the Body Refining Realm, was once invincible in the mortal world. He easily passed the Ascension Trial and ascended to the Immortal World. There, he learned that his homeland—the Nine Skies Continent—was on the brink of destruction. Without hesitation, Ye Cangxuan chose to return. At the same time, the Six Sects were collapsing. Demons and devils from the Outer Lands were poised to invade, and their spies had already infiltrated the Nine Skies Continent. Determined to change his homeland's fate, Ye Cangxuan embarked on a grueling quest. He reunited the Six Sects, broke into the Barbaric Wastes, wiped out demons and devils, and challenged the immortals themselves. In the end, he stood against the Sky itself.

(Source: Youku)

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus, a project that was started a few years ago, is the newly ENHANCED edition of the anime Dragon Ball Super. ENHANCED by the latest visual expression, every scene, especially the battle scenes, is even more immersive, providing a more faithful and detailed reproduction of the original work by Akira Toriyama, and it will deliver a quality that is sure to fully satisfy audiences.

(Source: Official website)

title_english: Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol
synopsis:
The main character, Son Goku, and Vegeta, work together with the members of the Galactic Patrol, the peacekeepers of the galaxy, to begin a super scale battle against a new enemy, "Planet-Eater" Moro! 

(Source: Official site, edited)

title_english: Nippon Sangoku: The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun
synopsis:
In the near future, Japan has completely collapsed due to a mix of nuclear warfare, natural disasters, and widespread corruption that sparked a revolution.

The country is now split into three warring superpowers. This new era of the Three Kingdoms Period sees diplomacy vanish, replaced by a harsh, relentless fight for power. Each territory is using its military strength and resources against the others in a desperate attempt for total control over the remnants of Japanese land.

Aoteru Misumi is a low-ranking official who has stayed in the background for most of his life. He does not come from a prestigious military background or aristocracy, but Misumi has a strong ambition: to end the pointless bloodshed that afflicts the nation. He seeks to unify the fractured country, armed only with sharp insight and a persuasive voice that can rally the people.

The legend of the man who will become a brilliant military strategist starts now.

(Source: MAL News)

The protagonist of the tale, simply referred to as "I," experiences an endless cycle of reincarnation. The narrative takes place in a different universe where people are free to select their next form. However, the waiting list for popular roles, like "Demon King" or "Hero with Cheat Skills and a Harem," has reached 50,000 years due to a recent spike in applications.

The protagonist decides to repeatedly reincarnate into increasingly strange forms because he refuses to wait. These roles include the rib of a hero in charge of a harem, a hermit crab, a vegetable, and even an explosive used to blow up blissfully happy couples.

(Source: MAL News)

Yi Wu was thrust onto the World Cup stage because of a single online "like." He then inexplicably appeared in a closed arena, where a countdown was implanted in everyone. To gain time to survive, they had to engage in a new, multi-strategy competition, escape perilous environments, and navigate secret chambers. This unique environment forced them to both cooperate and compete, and behind it all, a legend of a "spiritual kingdom" seemed to be circulating.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
A new short animation for the Evangelion series that debuted at the "EVANGELION:30+; 30th ANN/VERSARY OF EVANGELION" fes. in Yokohama Arena.

In the distant future, Kagami Village is a suburban mountain village that has been left behind by the highly developed science and technology in urban areas. "If you're not well behaved, a look-alike will come." Higure Akane, a middle school student living in this village where an old legend still remains, was looking forward to being reunited with her older sister Higure Sui, who has been released from the hospital after a year. However, shortly after her sister's release from the hospital, Akane receives a phone call. "The person in that house is not your older sister."

(Source: Official site, translated)

title_english: I'm a Witch Who's Crush Requested a Love Potion
synopsis:
Deep within the forest, a cozy and rather cluttered cottage sits on the lakeshore, housing a mysterious, feared witch. In truth, she is a lovely young woman named Rose, who has learned the art of potion-making from her wise grandmother. Rose cherishes her tucked-away life, yet there is a longing in her heart—for a handsome knight she once saw, Sir Harij Azm.

For four years, Rose's feelings for Harij have lingered, but she can never act on them; witches live outside of human affairs and belong to no country or man. So, when Harij suddenly appears on her doorstep looking for a love potion, Rose is both surprised and heartbroken. Although another woman has captured the noble knight's heart, Rose decides to help him. But before crafting the potion, Rose sends Harij on a series of ridiculous quests for each ingredient, hoping to delay the inevitable and savor their fleeting time together.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

The short film tells the story of a French philosopher named Sophie, who visits Fukushima Prefecture for the first time to attend a friend's wedding. Sophie loses her way in Fukushima, but a mysterious "friend" and a "map" appear before her, and she follows their lead making detours and stops. Little by little, Sophie realizes that everything in Fukushima is a "culture" that has been created by someone and has been passed down through generations.

(Source: ANN)

title_english: Dragon's Triumph in the Celestial Realm
synopsis:
The story unfolds in a fantastical martial arts world where ordinary people can unleash their mental and physical potential through continuous martial arts practice and internal energy cultivation. The protagonist, Lin Chen, is an ordinary martial artist of humble origins who strives for the pinnacle of skill. 

After experiencing injustice, his anger triggers his inner mental potential, entering a state of "Mind Awareness" similar to a quantum effect. However, this also allows him to witness the terrible danger his family faces in the future. Therefore, to protect his family and loved ones from fatal harm and to investigate the mystery of his father's disappearance, Lin Chen uses a mysterious list as a clue to uncover the truth behind everything, engaging in a perilous and arduous struggle against evil forces, thus weaving a legendary and moving tale.

(Source: Youku, translated)

Briar, Bramble and Vick encounter the legendary Year Monster, Nian, who bestows them with mysterious powers, thrusting them into the hidden, chaotic, magic-infused realm of Eve City.

(Source: IMDb)

Something big is happening in Forest Town again!?

Join the Helper Team for an immersive experience of traditional customs and feel the vibrant atmosphere of a traditional festival!

(Source: Douban, translated)

title_english: The Regression of Great Sage Riddle
synopsis:
A young man named Riddle had lost all of his friends—and the entire world—at the hands of a mysterious organization known as the "Box of Malice." Having lost all hope to live, he dwelled in a pit of despair until he has one final revelation. What if... he could return to a time before everything ended? And so, after a thousand years, a deformed Riddle finally manages to reverse time. "I'm going to stop them this time...!" Equipped with a thousand years of knowledge and experience in his young body, the Great Sage Riddle's journey to the past now unfolds!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
Eighth season of Chuldong! Super Wings.
Ninth season of Chuldong! Super Wings.

Forced into a marriage of convenience based on mutual benefit, Jiang Yuan, an assassin from the Tai Xuan Tower, and Shao Yue, the holy maiden of the Jiu Xuan Sect, are ordered to marry. On their wedding night, they attempt an assassination, only to discover they are both immortal. To obtain the Demon-Suppressing Bell and the Demon-Controlling Bell, secret treasures of each other's sects, they transform from mortal enemies into a facade of marriage, engaging in a charade of mutual deception. 

However, neither is aware that the other is also an alien survivor whose home was destroyed by the "Void." This destined couple forms an alliance amidst suspicion and testing, not only searching for the treasures transformed from a lost spaceship but also confronting the ever-watchful cultivation world, seeking hope to defeat the "Void" amidst perilous circumstances.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

synopsis:
A "dark veil" suddenly appears in the real world, prompting the little fairies to return to the Realm of Illusion to investigate. It turns out that the Realm of Illusion is being rebuilt, and Nightfall, along with her mysterious agents and the Dark Stars, has returned, attempting to dominate the magical world.

(Source: Douban, translated)

Ritsu inherited his sixth sense from his grandfather, along with a demon guardian named Blue Storm. Strange things just seem to happen around these two, and it's left to them to get to the bottom of all these mysterious events. Each story is independent but features recurring characters you'll come to know and appreciate as they, each in their own way, try to deal with things 'not of this world'.

(Source: MU)

On rainy days, Hina Katagiri always dreams about her younger self playing with a mysterious boy, but she assumes these thoughts are nothing more than a childhood fantasy. Now a high school student, she focuses on her club activities and protecting her great-grandmother's necklace.

While at school, Hina is inexplicably transported to the backyard of a mansion, where she is greeted by one of its inhabitants, Takaaki Hongou. He mistakes the girl for his fiancée, Hinako Kitamine, but Hina, believing she is in a dream, plays along with the misunderstanding. It is when Hina comes face-to-face with the real Hinako that she realizes the severity of her situation: somehow, she has been sent to the year 1907. In addition, she has lost her heirloom necklace at Takaaki's house. With Hinako's assistance, Hina continues to masquerade as her in order to access the Hongou household. However, Hina's plan begins to fall apart when she starts to develop feelings for Takaaki, all while the path to her fo

Ye Xi was an ordinary girl, nothing special. She wasn't the worst at anything, but she was never the best either. She was as invisible as air, utterly unremarkable. Until she met Li Zhao…

Li Zhao had her own goals; she wanted to become a top fashion designer. From a young age, every step she took was a step closer to her dream.

This is the story of a group of girls who met through fashion and are pursuing their dreams, occasionally interspersed with some lighthearted and silly everyday moments!

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

The Sage of Wind, Ephtal is a reincarnated human, coming from modern Earth. Reincarnated in a new world where magic is real, he decides to devote the entirety of his life in the pursuit of magic. Despite his efforts, though, he discovers that he is absolutely talentless in magic, and breathed his last in anguish.

But it isn't the end for him just yet! He reincarnates once again bearing the same name, Ephtal, 400 years later. Having retained his knowledge and power, he steels his resolve and once again sets his sights for the peak of magic!

However, in a surprising turn of events, he discovers that magic has terribly declined. In this era where powerful spells are a rarity, his talentless self is now completely unmatched! From the depths of powerlessness to the peak of power, the talentless but peerless mage's journey to the top starts now!

(Source: Manga UP!, edited)

Dante's life on Amigasa seemed normal enough to him, even though everyone around him called him an oddball. But when a chance meeting with a young woman named Aoi changes everything, Dante can no longer sit idly by...unless, of course, he is made to!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him. The tiny human is Eve, and despite being only five years of age, she has somehow endured the many dangers that surround them. In an act of pity, the dragon decides to raise her as his own...but his time is still running out.

After five years together, he takes his last breath, leaving his precious daughter on her own. Little does the dragon know, Eve is capable of more than he realizes, and their reunion may be sooner than he thinks...

Hoping to improve Eve's control over her magical abilities before his resurrected body gives out, the skull dragon sets out on an adventure with his reckless human daughter—but who knows what kind of trouble awaits them?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

synopsis:
Ye Fan and Wang Teng, two top geniuses, face each other in a fated battle. The Wang family from Beiyuan arrives with great power, while the Ji family’s elder is secretly plotting something, and Ji Ziyue is forced into a political marriage. Surrounded by enemies, Ye Fan becomes everyone’s target. As the Ancient Sacred Body clashes with ancient powers, who will rise as the true Great Emperor?

title_english: The Forsaken Saintess and her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World
synopsis:
Rin Takanashi, a caregiver in her thirties, was unceremoniously discarded as "trash" despite being summoned as a saint.

However, as a lover of the great outdoors and all things camping, she was blessed with a special skill, [Survival], as well as another unique skill! Thus, a riveting tale begins: one of sweat, tears, and insatiable hunger as Rin, together with companions she picked up along the way, leisurely explores this parallel world and savors gourmet cuisine to her heart's content...

Or so the story should have gone, but it looks like their road is going in an unexpected direction...?

(Source: MU)

title_english: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
synopsis:
Koharu Satou is known to her classmates as the "unattainable flower" a cold and distant girl whose refusal to smile keeps everyone at arm's length.

However, Souta Oshio accidentally stumbles upon Satou's secret at her family's cafe. It turns out the "icy Satou-san" is actually an incredibly shy and clumsy girl who struggles even with something as simple as taking photos of sweets for the cafe's social media.

Bonding over their shared love for cameras and desserts, the distance between the two gradually shrinks. This charming romantic comedy follows two socially awkward people as they navigate their feelings in a story that is as sweet as it is endearing.

(Source: MAL News)
Four recap episodes of Ojamajo Doremi released on VHS.

title_english: Magical Buffs: The Support Caster Is Stronger Than He Realized!
synopsis:
Wim Strauss is a "granting caster"—a support mage who can increase the strength of his allies through the power of his spells. It's a useful talent, but since it can't be used directly in battle, it gets zero respect from the other members of his party. As far as they're concerned, support magic is dead weight. It isn't long before they toss him out on his ear, leaving Wim to wonder if his career as an adventurer is over.

Lucky for Wim, he has one big chance: his childhood friend Heidemarie is able to get him an audition with her elite A-rank party, Nachtlibelle. The two of them know his magic is good for more than just menial backup, but now he'll have to prove it. It's time to show the world that support mages can do more than just stand on the back lines!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

"I want you to protect me," she requests, tired of having her life trivialized. Seeking a place to survive, the witch and the mercenary set their sights on an unknown continent!

(Source: Kodansha)

Oh, to be young and in love. Oh, to be wild and carefree. The springtime of life is intense, tumultuous, and at times, oh so confusing. Spring, summer, fall and winter—love blossoms in all seasons.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

The continent of Yulan is a magical world teeming with wondrous creatures and dazzling magic. One day, Linley Baruch, a young nobleman from the impoverished town of Wushan, stepped into his dusty ancestral home and inadvertently obtained a seemingly ordinary ring—the Dragon Ring—thus changing his life forever. With the help of the Ringwraith Delin Corvort, Linley embarks on his legendary journey, and a great magician is born. The boy from the small town, through his relentless struggle and unyielding spirit, constantly strives for higher realms, step by step reaching the pinnacle of power through trials that teem with life and death.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title_english: A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage
synopsis:
Forty-year-old detective Eiji Kirisame has found maybe the strangest witness of his life: a silent high school girl named Tsugumi Kuchinashi who was at the scene of the crime. Her statements mostly consist of shoddy doodles on a drawing pad, but Eiji is no stranger to piecing together the truth from limited evidence. He'll take every page seriously if it might help solve the case. But why does the last page say... "Will you marry me?!"

(Source: Yen Press)

The world is an illusion, but love is real. At eighteen, Gao Yang accidentally discovers the cruel truth of the world: his family and friends are all terrifying "beasts," and these "beasts" will kill anyone who discovers the truth. Facing the "beasts'" frenzied attacks, Gao Yang, on the verge of death, activates a mysterious system and awakens his talent Luck, thus beginning a game of survival between lamb and wolf…

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

title_english: The Case Files of Biblia Bookstore
synopsis:
Hidden away in a corner of Kamakura is an unassuming secondhand bookstore, the Biblia Antiquarian Bookshop. Shinokawa Shioriko, the owner of the shop, is an overly shy young and beautiful woman who doesn't fit the image of a used bookstore and often has trouble interacting with customers.

While customer service isn't her strong point, she more than makes up for it in other ways. Using her exhaustive knowledge and unrivaled passion for literature, she unravels the secrets and mysteries of the antiquarian books that come into her shop.

This is a story of secrets and rare books.

(Source: Nanodesu Translation)
